title: WINDSHIELD WASHER RESERVOIR FLUID LEVEL MONITOR WITH RPO C60
summary: RPO CD2 washer fluid level monitor on cars with C60 air conditioning: the float sending unit drops through the washer reservoir cap (cap is part of the reservoir) and is held by a retainer under the cap; a bulb plugs into the sending unit and the wire assembly carries the circuit along the cowl, through the existing clip and tach cable grommet area, to the wiper motor connector (purple wire). The white ground lead is screwed with a washer to the distributor & coil shield support bracket. Excess wire is coiled and taped.

parts.name: SENDING UNIT ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Washer fluid level sending unit assembly (float)

fastening.note: View A: sending unit [3] tube goes down through the cap; retainer [9] fits on it under the cap.

fastening.to: distributor & coil shield support bracket (.128/.132 dia hole)
fastening.note: Screw [5] with washer [6] through the eyelet of the WHITE lead into the hole in the support bracket, located 1.12 and .56 as dimensioned.
Note A: 8 in. tape [8] required, 4 in. at (2) places; excess wire and conductor coiled and taped (View A and main view).
Wire assembly [2] PURPLE lead plugs into the wiper motor connector; harness runs through the EXISTING CLIP alongside the washer hose, past the tach cable grommet.
Bulb [4] plugs into the socket on the sending unit; wire asm [2] socket plugs onto it (View A).

notes: [A] 8 in. req'd 4 in. (2) places. Coil excess wire & conductor & tape.
